decision: How should a tenant brand override be modelled in WF-138?

state.change: A brand belongs to an account and carries tenant token overrides. A room joins a brand and inherits the brand's current tokens. White-label mode swaps the owner identity presented to a buyer.
state.question: What is a tenant brand override allowed to contain?
state.option_a_token_to_token: An override maps one of this product's own semantic tokens to another one, for example {accent: accent-bright}. The pair renders on the branded host as --color-accent: var(--color-accent-bright). The four tokens that decide text contrast (background, surface, foreground, muted-foreground) are locked at both ends: a tenant may neither override them nor point another token at them.
state.option_b_colour_values: An override stores validated colour values per token, reusing WF-017's is_valid_colour grammar, for example {accent: '#22c55e'}.
state.option_c_stylesheet: An override stores custom properties or a stylesheet supplied by the tenant.
evidence_for_a: The issue is explicit: 'Token names, not raw hex' and 'Model the override as a token-to-token mapping.'

docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md: 'Style with semantic tokens. Never with a raw hex value ... Because tokens live in one file, a palette change lands everywhere at once. If you hardcode a colour you have opted out of that, permanently.'
The design system states 4.5:1 text contrast and a locked light theme as the floor, so the four tokens that decide contrast have to stay the product's.
frontend/src/index.css declares every colour as --color-<token>, so a token pair renders with no colour value ever leaving the stylesheet.
WF-017's own module docstring records that its is_valid_colour grammar is wider than intended: a bare 3-20 letter word is accepted, so inherit, initial, unset and javascript all pass.
evidence_for_b: WF-017 already ships per-room colour-valued branding, so the product would then hold two override shapes.
evidence_for_c: A tenant could express anything the CSS parser allows, at the cost of an injection surface and a palette nothing can verify.
state.measurement: backend/tests/test_wf138.py carries eight tests over the token map, including a parametrised refusal of #10506f, #fff, rgb(16,80,111), hsl(200, 40%, 20%) and a named colour, and a refusal of all four product-locked tokens on both sides of a pair. The page offers only selects over the token names, and asserts that no colour input exists.

verdict.instructions: Which model should WF-138 adopt for a tenant brand override?

criteria.adopt_token_to_token: Map token to token. The product keeps the palette and the contrast floor, a tenant can never inject a value, and a later theme change still reaches every tenant.
criteria.prefer_colour_values: Store a validated colour value per token, as WF-017 does per room, and accept that a tenant can opt out of the palette.
criteria.prefer_stylesheet: Let a tenant supply custom properties or a stylesheet.
